m = math min,max,abs,cos,sin,tan,acos,asin,atan,pi,pi2 = m.min,m.max,m.abs,m.cos,m.sin,m.tan,m.acos,m.asin,m.atan,m.pi,m.pi*2 PIDs = {} -- PID -- @param Kp number QC -- @param Ki number QC -- @param Kd number QC -- @param Kid number gQC -- @param iMin number l -- @param iMax number l -- @param dMin number l -- @param dMax number l -- @param min number ol -- @param max number ol function createPID(Kp, Ki, Kd, Kid, iMin, iMax, dMin, dMax, min, max) local pid = {} pid.Kp,pid.Ki,pid.Kd = Kp,Ki,Kd pid.prevError,pid.integral = 0,0
function pid:calculate(setpoint, measuredValue) local error = setpoint - measuredValue local derivative = clamp(error - self.prevError, dMin, dMax) self.integral = self.Ki == 0 and 0 or clamp((self.integral + error) - Kid * (error - self.prevError), iMin / self.Ki, iMax / self.Ki) local output = clamp(self.Kp * error + self.Ki * self.integral + self.Kd * derivative, min, max) self.prevError = error return output end return pid end function clamp(X,MIN,MAX)return min(max(X ,MIN) ,MAX)end
idlePIDParams = {Kp = 0.15, Ki = 0.05, Kd = 0, Kid = 0.2, iMin = 0, iMax = 1, dMin = -0.2, dMax = 0.2, min = 0, max = 1} idlePID = createPID(idlePIDParams.Kp, idlePIDParams.Ki, idlePIDParams.Kd, idlePIDParams.Kid, idlePIDParams.iMin, idlePIDParams.iMax, idlePIDParams.dMin, idlePIDParams.dMax, idlePIDParams.min, idlePIDParams.max) -- GWs -- X^[^[ON/OFFAAChOARs -- @param key boolean GWL[ONOFF -- @param throttle number Xbgl (0-1) -- @param rps number GWRPS (0-60) -- @param temp number GWx -- @param airPressure number V_[R|Wbg1ch -- @param fuelPressure number V_[R|Wbg2ch -- @param EP_balance number R/p[ (0-1) function engineControl(key, throttle, rps,temp, airPressure, fuelPressure, EP_balance)
local egRestartRPS = 2 local idleTargetRPS = 3 local useIdlePIDRPS = 5 local rpsLimit = 25 local rpsLimitGain = 0.2
local starter = false local airThrottle = 0 local fuelThrottle = 0
if (key == true) then starter = rps < egRestartRPS if (rps < useIdlePIDRPS) then throttle = throttle + idlePID:calculate(idleTargetRPS, rps) -- AChOPIDvZ end
throttle = clamp(throttle, 0, 1) -- Xbgl0-1 throttle = clamp((rpsLimit - rps)*rpsLimitGain, 0, 1) * throttle -- XbglRPS airThrottle = throttle fuelThrottle = airPressure/(.0000396*rps*(13.33-.0058*temp-.000063*temp^2)) end
return {starter = starter, throttle = throttle, airThrottle = airThrottle, fuelThrottle = fuelThrottle} end
function onTick() Seat = {bool = {}, number = {}} for i = 1, 6 do Seat.bool[i] = input.getBool(i)end for i = 1, 4 do Seat.number[i] = input.getNumber(i)end
Engine = {} Engine.airPressure = input.getNumber(11) Engine.fuelPressure = input.getNumber(12) Engine.temp = input.getNumber(13) Engine.rps = input.getNumber(14)
Output = {} Output.Engine = engineControl(Seat.bool[1], max(Seat.number[2], 0), Engine.rps, Engine.temp, Engine.airPressure, Engine.fuelPressure, 0)
output.setBool(1, Output.Engine.starter) output.setNumber(1, Output.Engine.throttle) output.setNumber(2, Output.Engine.airThrottle) output.setNumber(3, Output.Engine.fuelThrottle) end

SteeringParams = { targetSlipSpeed = 5, fullThrottleTargetSlipSpeed = 3, accuracy = 0.001, } ClutchParams = { targetSlipSpeed = 5, fullSteerTargetSlipSpeed = 4, FBRato = 1, -- OzC[Xbvxi+OA0SA-j inSideOutSideRatio = 1, -- zC[OzC[Xbvxi+OA0SA-j PIDGain = { Kp = 0.05, Ki = 0.01, Kd = 0, Kid = 0, iMin = -0.2, iMax = 1, dMin = 0, dMax = 1, min = -0.2, max = 1 }, brakeGain = 5 }
BrakeParams = { gain = 1.1, FBRato = 1, -- OzC[Xbvxi+OA0SA-j inSideOutSideRatio = -1, -- zC[OzC[Xbvxi+OA0SA-j }
wheelRadius = property.getNumber("wheelRadius") or 0.35 wheelPosition = { -- Physics Sensor base wheel offset (unit: m) FL={x=property.getNumber("FL Wheel Sensor OffsetX"),y=property.getNumber("FL Wheel Sensor OffsetY"),z=property.getNumber("FL Wheel Sensor OffsetZ")}, FR={x=property.getNumber("FR Wheel Sensor OffsetX"),y=property.getNumber("FR Wheel Sensor OffsetY"),z=property.getNumber("FR Wheel Sensor OffsetZ")}, RL={x=property.getNumber("RL Wheel Sensor OffsetX"),y=property.getNumber("RL Wheel Sensor OffsetY"),z=property.getNumber("RL Wheel Sensor OffsetZ")}, RR={x=property.getNumber("RR Wheel Sensor OffsetX"),y=property.getNumber("RR Wheel Sensor OffsetY"),z=property.getNumber("RR Wheel Sensor OffsetZ")} }
function createPID(Kp, Ki, Kd, Kid, iMin, iMax, dMin, dMax, min, max) local pid = {} pid.Kp,pid.Ki,pid.Kd = Kp,Ki,Kd pid.prevError,pid.integral = 0,0
function pid:calculate(setpoint, measuredValue, scale) local error = (setpoint - measuredValue) * (scale or 1) local derivative = clamp(error - self.prevError, dMin, dMax) self.integral = self.Ki == 0 and 0 or clamp((self.integral + error) - Kid * (error - self.prevError), iMin / self.Ki, iMax / self.Ki) local output = clamp(self.Kp * error + self.Ki * self.integral + self.Kd * derivative, min, max) self.prevError = error return output end function pid:reset()self.prevError, self.integral = 0, 0 end return pid end
ClutchPID, BrakePID = {}, {} for key, value in pairs(wheelPosition) do local G = ClutchParams.PIDGain ClutchPID[key] = createPID(G.Kp,G.Ki,G.Kd,G.Kid,G.iMin,G.iMax,G.dMin,G.dMax,G.min,G.max) end
function lerp(MIN,MAX,X)return (1 - X) * MIN + X * MAX;end function lerp2(MIN,MAX,X)return lerp(MIN, MAX, (1 + X) / 2)end function sgn(X)return X < 0 and -1 or 1;end function clamp(X, MIN, MAX)return math.min(math.max(X, MIN), MAX)end
function onTick() physics = getPhysics() wheelRPS = { FL = input.getNumber(18), FR = input.getNumber(19), RL = input.getNumber(20), RR = input.getNumber(21) } wheelPhysics = {} for key, value in pairs(wheelPosition) do wheelPhysics[key] = calcWheelPhysics(key) end
steeringInput = input.getNumber(22) throttleInput = clamp(input.getNumber(23), 0, 1) steeringOutput = {FL = 0, FR = 0} -- use only front wheels steeringOutput = calcSteering(steeringInput, throttleInput, steeringOutput) output.setNumber(1, -steeringOutput.FL) output.setNumber(2, steeringOutput.FR)
ClutchOutput, BrakeOutput = calcClutch() output.setNumber(5, ClutchOutput["FL"]) output.setNumber(6, ClutchOutput["FR"]) output.setNumber(7, ClutchOutput["RL"]) output.setNumber(8, ClutchOutput["RR"])
brakeInput = clamp(-input.getNumber(23), 0, 1) BrakeOutput = calcBrake(brakeInput, BrakeOutput) output.setNumber(9 , BrakeOutput.FL) output.setNumber(10, BrakeOutput.FR) output.setNumber(11, BrakeOutput.RL) output.setNumber(12, BrakeOutput.RR)
output.setNumber(20, wheelRPS.FL * wheelRadius*math.pi*2 - calcSlipSpeed(wheelPhysics.FL, steeringOutput.FL or 0).z) -- for debug end
function calcSteering(steeringInput, throttleInput, steeringOutput) local count = 0 for key, value in pairs(steeringOutput) do
local rangePositive, rangeNegative, found = -2, 2, false
for i = -1, 1, SteeringParams.accuracy do -- steering range -1 to 1 -- zC[x slipSpeed = calcSlipSpeed(wheelPhysics[key], i) slipSpeed = math.abs(slipSpeed.x) + math.abs(slipSpeed.z - wheelRPS[key] * wheelRadius*math.pi*2)
-- targetSlipSpeed local targetSlipSpeed = lerp(SteeringParams.targetSlipSpeed, SteeringParams.fullThrottleTargetSlipSpeed, throttleInput) if slipSpeed < targetSlipSpeed then rangeNegative = math.min(rangeNegative, i) rangePositive = math.max(rangePositive, i) found = true end end
if found then steeringOutput[key] = lerp2(rangeNegative, rangePositive, steeringInput) else steeringOutput[key] = steeringInput / math.max(math.abs(wheelPhysics[key].z), 1) * 0 -- if no answer is found end count = count+2 end
return steeringOutput end
function calcClutch() ClutchTargetRatio = { FL = 1 + ClutchParams.inSideOutSideRatio * sgn(steeringInput) + ClutchParams.FBRato, FR = 1 - ClutchParams.inSideOutSideRatio * sgn(steeringInput) + ClutchParams.FBRato, RL = 1 + ClutchParams.inSideOutSideRatio * sgn(steeringInput) - ClutchParams.FBRato, RR = 1 - ClutchParams.inSideOutSideRatio * sgn(steeringInput) - ClutchParams.FBRato }
ClutchOutput, BrakeOutput = {}, {} for key, _clutchTargetRatio in pairs(ClutchTargetRatio) do local clutchTargetSlipSpeed = lerp(ClutchParams.targetSlipSpeed, _clutchTargetRatio, math.abs(steeringInput)) local wheelSpeed = wheelRPS[key] * wheelRadius*math.pi*2 local slipSpeed = wheelSpeed - calcSlipSpeed(wheelPhysics[key] or calcWheelPhysics(key), steeringOutput[key] or 0).z
ClutchOutput[key] = ClutchPID[key]:calculate(clutchTargetSlipSpeed, slipSpeed) BrakeOutput[key] = clamp(-ClutchOutput[key] * ClutchParams.brakeGain, 0, 1) ClutchOutput[key] = clamp(ClutchOutput[key]*0.68+0.32, 0.32, 1) end return ClutchOutput, BrakeOutput end
function calcBrake(brakeInput, BrakeOutput) BrakeTargetRatio = { FL = 1 + BrakeParams.inSideOutSideRatio * sgn(steeringInput) + BrakeParams.FBRato, FR = 1 - BrakeParams.inSideOutSideRatio * sgn(steeringInput) + BrakeParams.FBRato, RL = 1 + BrakeParams.inSideOutSideRatio * sgn(steeringInput) - BrakeParams.FBRato, RR = 1 - BrakeParams.inSideOutSideRatio * sgn(steeringInput) - BrakeParams.FBRato }
for key, _brakeTargetRatio in pairs(BrakeTargetRatio) do local speed = math.max(math.abs(wheelRPS[key] * wheelRadius*math.pi*2), 1) BrakeOutput[key] = (BrakeOutput[key] + brakeInput) * BrakeTargetRatio[key]* BrakeParams.gain / slipSpeed BrakeOutput[key] = clamp(BrakeOutput[key], 0, 1) end return BrakeOutput end
function getPhysics() local x, y, z = input.getNumber(4), input.getNumber(5), input.getNumber(6) local ax, ay, az = input.getNumber(10), input.getNumber(11), input.getNumber(12)
local cx, cy, cz = math.cos(x), math.cos(y), math.cos(z) local sx, sy, sz = math.sin(x), math.sin(y), math.sin(z)
local m00, m01, m02 = (cy*cz), (-cx*sz + sx*sy*cz), (sx*sz + cx*sy*cz) local m10, m11, m12 = (cy*sz), (cx*cz + sx*sy*sz), (-sx*cz + cx*sy*sz) local m20, m21, m22 = (-sy), (sx*cy), (cx*cy)
return { spdX = input.getNumber(7), spdY = input.getNumber(8), spdZ = input.getNumber(9), angSpdX = m00*ax + m10*ay + m20*az, angSpdY = m01*ax + m11*ay + m21*az, angSpdZ = m02*ax + m12*ay + m22*az } end
function calcWheelPhysics(wheelKey) local pos = wheelPosition[wheelKey] local rX, rY, rZ = pos.x, pos.y, pos.z
local omegaX = physics.angSpdX -- Pitch local omegaY = physics.angSpdY -- Yaw local omegaZ = physics.angSpdZ -- Roll
local crossX = omegaY * rZ - omegaZ * rY local crossZ = omegaX * rY - omegaY * rX
local wheelVelX = physics.spdX + crossX local wheelVelZ = physics.spdZ + crossZ
return { x = wheelVelX, z = wheelVelZ } end
function calcSlipSpeed(wheelPhysics, steeringRadian) local wheelVelCarX = wheelPhysics.x local wheelVelCarZ = wheelPhysics.z
local cosTheta = math.cos(steeringRadian) local sinTheta = math.sin(steeringRadian)
local slipSpeedX = wheelVelCarX * cosTheta + wheelVelCarZ * sinTheta -- wheel local spd facing right local slipSpeedZ = -wheelVelCarX * sinTheta + wheelVelCarZ * cosTheta -- wheel local spd facing forward return { x = slipSpeedX, z = slipSpeedZ } end

function drawGear(offsetX, offsetY, mode, gear, mt) local gearTable = {" ","P","R","N","D"," "}
setColor(color.text.disable) drawText35(offsetX, offsetY, gearTable[mode]) drawText35(offsetX+13, offsetY, gearTable[mode+2])
setColor(color.text.green) dT(offsetX+6, offsetY, gearTable[mode+1])
dT(offsetX+6, offsetY+6, "G") drawText35(offsetX+13, offsetY+6, clamp(gear,0,9))
setColor(color.gray) dT(offsetX+10, offsetY+6, ":")
setColor(mt and color.text.red or color.text.disable) dT(offsetX, offsetY+6, "A")
setColor(color.darkGray) dL(offsetX+4, offsetY+2, offsetX+4, offsetY+3) -- < dL(offsetX+5, offsetY+1, offsetX+5, offsetY+4)
dL(offsetX+11, offsetY+2, offsetX+11, offsetY+3) -- > dL(offsetX+10, offsetY+1, offsetX+10, offsetY+4) end
function drawSpeed(offsetX, offsetY, speed) speed = string.format("%03d", clamp(speed//1, 0, 999)) --max 999km/h,non decimal drawNumber57(offsetX, offsetY, speed) end
function drawSeatIndicator(offsetX, offsetY, ad, brake, throttle) local r, ad, a = 4.3, ad*1.8 setColor(color.seatIndicator.steering) for i = -1, 1 do -- innner a=(i+ad+1)*m.pi/2 local x, y = m.cos(a), m.sin(a) dL(offsetX+8, offsetY+4, offsetX+8+(x*r+0.5)//1, offsetY+4+(y*r+0.5)//1) end
for i=1,24 do -- steering circle a=i/24*m.pi*2-m.pi dT(offsetX+7+(m.cos(a)*r+0.5)//1, offsetY+(m.sin(a)*r+0.5)//1, ".") end
setColor(color.seatIndicator.adDot) a=(ad+1)*m.pi/2-m.pi -- steering dot dT(offsetX+7+(m.cos(a)*r+0.5)//1, offsetY+(m.sin(a)*r+0.5)//1,".")
setColor(color.seatIndicator.backGround) dRF(offsetX, offsetY, 3, 9) dRF(offsetX+14, offsetY, 3, 9)
setColor(color.seatIndicator.brake) brake = clamp(brake, 0, 1) dRF(offsetX, offsetY+9, 3, -brake*9//1)
setColor(color.seatIndicator.throttle) throttle = clamp(throttle, 0, 1) dRF(offsetX+14, offsetY+9, 3, -throttle*9//1) end
function drawFuel(offsetX, offsetY, fuel, capacity, range) setColor(color.fuelIndicator.backGround) dRF(offsetX, offsetY, 20,5)
setColor(color.fuelIndicator.fuel) local fuelLevel = clamp(fuel/capacity, 0, 1) dRF(offsetX+29, offsetY, -fuelLevel*29, 5)
setColor(color.separator) dL(offsetX+3, offsetY+1, offsetX+3, offsetY+4)
setColor(color.text.gray) dL(offsetX+14, offsetY+1, offsetX+14, offsetY+4) -- "L" dL(offsetX+14, offsetY+4, offsetX+16, offsetY+4)
dL(offsetX+26, offsetY+1, offsetX+26, offsetY+5) -- "k" dL(offsetX+28, offsetY+2, offsetX+28, offsetY+3) dL(offsetX+27, offsetY+3, offsetX+29, offsetY+5)
setColor(color.text.white) dL(offsetX, offsetY, offsetX+2, offsetY) -- "F" dL(offsetX, offsetY, offsetX, offsetY+5) dL(offsetX, offsetY+2, offsetX+2, offsetY+2)
fuel = string.format("%03d", clamp(fuel//1, 0, 999)) --max 999L,non decimal drawNumber25(offsetX+5, offsetY, fuel)
range = string.format("%03d", clamp(range//1, 0, 999)) --max 999km,non decimal drawNumber25(offsetX+17, offsetY, range) end
function setColor(color) local alpha = color[4] and color[4] or 255 -- nil=255 s.setColor(color[1],color[2],color[3],alpha) end function drawText35(k,i,l)local m,l,j,n,q,p,b,t=k,tostring(l),{31599,11415,29671,29391,23497,31183,31215,31305,31727,31689,11245,27566,14627,27502,31143,31140,14699,23533,29847,4970,23469,18727,29582,429,31601,31652,31585,27565,14478,29842,23407,23402,14563,23213,23186,29351}for d=1,#l do;n=l:byte(d)q,p=1,j[n>64 and n-54 or n-47]for r=0,14 do;if p and p%(q*2)>=q then;b=2-r%3;t=4-r//3;dL(m+b,i+t,m+b+1,i+t)end;q=q*2;end;m=m+4;end;end function drawNumber25(x,y,n)local p,d={{0,0,2,0},{1,0,1,3},{1,2,1,5},{0,4,2,4},{0,2,0,5},{0,1,0,3},{0,2,2,2}},{120,48,109,121,51,91,95,112,127,123}n=tostring(n)for i=1,#n do local t=d[n:byte(i)-47]if t then for j=1,7 do if(t>>(7-j))&1==1 then local g=p[j]dL(x+g[1],y+g[2],x+g[3],y+g[4])end end end x=x+3 end end function drawNumber57(x,y,n) local n,p,d,g,t=tostring(n),{{0,0,4,0},{3,0,3,4},{3,3,3,7},{0,6,4,6},{0,3,0,7},{0,0,0,4},{0,3,4,3}},{126,48,109,121,51,91,95,112,127,123}for i=1,#n do;t=d[n:byte(i)-47]for j=1,7 do;if t and (t>>(7-j))&1==1 then;g=p[j]dL(x+g[1],y+g[2],x+g[3],y+g[4])end;end;x=x+5;end;end function clamp(X, MIN, MAX)return m.min(m.max(X, MIN), MAX)end
